title: Digital Brutalism and the Search for Speed
subtitle: How eliminating unnecessary scripts and heavy assets leads to lightning-fast load times.
summary: Modern web applications have bloated beyond reason. Embracing digital brutalism offers a path back to speed, accessibility, and focus.

content.text: The average webpage today transfers megabytes of JavaScript tracking bundles, heavy font files, and unoptimized high-res marketing images before displaying a single paragraph of text.

Minimalist black and white design isn't merely an aesthetic choice; it's a structural optimization. By removing background hero videos and heavy graphic libraries, sub-millisecond initial content paints become standard.
When evaluated across key performance metrics, minimalist text-first pages achieve perfect Lighthouse benchmark scores naturally.
